concept.subject: A striped hot-air balloon rising through a pale morning sky, strung with pennant bunting, with six small balloons drifting around it.
concept.composition: The big balloon's envelope fills the middle of the board, its basket hangs low over the bucket's path; the bunting strings droop from the upper corners to the envelope's sides; the small balloons float in pairs, high above the strings, at mid height by the walls and low above the cloud banks that fill the lower corners.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 135 of them. The envelope is a curved grid: pegs along its outline and down the middle of its five inner panels. One peg sits on each pennant, rings of eight pegs surround the small balloons with one more peg on each balloon, peg lines follow the cloud tops and leave the lower corners to the flippers. Level 1 introduces ramps and blockers: two rails lie on the cloud tops near the side walls and slope toward the middle, and the basket is a blocker with a peaked top.

background.prompt: A large hot-air balloon floats in the center. Its round envelope fills the middle of the picture, from about one seventh to three quarters of the picture height and about one third of its width, made of broad vertical panels in alternating muted blue and cream with clearly visible curved seams running from its top to its bottom. A woven basket hangs below it on four short ropes, its bottom just above the lowest tenth of the picture. Two strings of small triangular pennant flags hang in gentle curves from the upper left and upper right corners down to the sides of the envelope. Six small distant striped balloons, each about a twentieth of the picture wide, float around it in pairs: one high on each side above the pennant strings (at about a quarter and three quarters of the width), one at mid height close to each side edge, and one low on each side just above the clouds. Soft cumulus clouds fill the lower corners and run along the bottom.
